Deliverable: How the work executes (the artifact this ships). Workstream = the mutable grouping category the work advances (the legacy 'Track' header is still read); SR-Refs = the requirement id(s) it delivers; Predecessors = the id(s) it depends on (the DAG edges; ;-joined) - a bare WI-### id is a hard edge (blocks; the acyclicity rule), a ~-prefixed WI id is a soft edge (advisory ordering; must resolve, never blocks, dashed in the render), and a bare OI-### id is a hard edge on an open-item ruling (blocks until that open item leaves pending; an open item is not a DAG node, so it is not subject to the acyclicity rule) - the grammar widened tolerantly (OI-73), so a bare WI id keeps meaning exactly what it always did; Status = queued|active|done|deferred|blocked|retired (retired is a TERMINAL won't-build row that stays in the registry forever with its reason in Deliverable - counted separately from done, never scheduled, SpecRef cleared). SSOT model (process-options.md 'Trajectory / work-items layer'): Deliverable is backward-only - EMPTY while open, filled with what shipped at close (R-A); SpecRef is the forward bridge - a docs/specs/WI-###.md file or a doc#anchor that resolves while the WI is open and clears at close (R-E). BuildTier = an OPTIONAL per-WI routing hint for the unattended coordinator (process-options.md 'Unattended operation') - strong|medium|quick (legacy weak reads as quick); the STARTING build tier for THIS work item's BUILD sessions, read from the WI row by the dispatcher and composing with tier-up-never-down escalation (never caps escalation); empty/absent = the phase-default routing (never-breaking, read by name). CritiqueBudget and CritiqueExhaustion are OPTIONAL per-WI critique-loop controls: budget is a positive integer or inf; exhaustion is move-on or block; absent preserves the global default + move-on. The OPTIONAL parallel-dispatch scheduler columns are Priority (integer, default 0 - deliberate ordering within a gate class), Exclusive (;-joined semantic mutex keys; empty = optimistic), EstTokens (draft-time size estimate), and SafetyClass (ordinary|spine|gate|attestation|protected|high-risk; absent fails closed as unclassified so a repo enables parallelism only after its SafetyClass audit), PlanMode (dual opts a WI into dual-plan decomposition; empty = normal build), and Bar (optional DevStg-Reqs|DevStg-Tests|DevStg-Impl: bar declares verification strictness for this row's lane; it never affects scheduling) - a legacy CSV without them reads every value as its default. status.md is an integrator-generated snapshot; the registry is authoritative. Execution 'how' atop the spine's 'what' - a view, never a source of truth. This -000 row is inert (check_trajectory.py ignores it), so a fresh scaffold stays vacuously clean.
